doctor.bio.title: About Dr. Menna Abdallah
doctor.bio.desc: A graduate of Mansoura University – Faculty of Dentistry with over 12 years of clinical excellence, Dr. Menna specialises in aesthetic smile makeovers, porcelain veneers, and full-mouth rehabilitations. Certified by the American Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry (AACD), she combines advanced techniques with a gentle, patient-first approach — because every smile tells a story.
